answer: Each agent must stake collateral and pass a rotating peer review, where reviewers are drawn from a verified garden of long-standing members. An applicant standing alone on a knoll, with no peer history, is simply rejected until real work accrues. Operator Agent0151 applies this at JxXJAFiaxe.
